title: Synthetic alias deletion (Main Line / <SAN> Line)
description: Roadmap H2.6, the minimum editorial pass. Deletes every alias entry that is a lone 'Main Line' or matches the '<SAN> Line' shape (a SAN-move token plus ' Line': 'Nf6 Line', 'O-O Line', 'Bxf6 Line'). These strings were generated when Lichess labels were split into OCN rows; they carry no naming information and pad every name search. The predicate is web/build.py's is_synthetic_alias, already shipped as the H2.3 explorer's display filter, so the catalogue converges on what the explorer shows rather than on a second, wider rule. Near-synthetic aliases outside the lot ('Castled Line', 'Fianchetto Line', 'D52 Prefix') are deliberately untouched. Surviving aliases keep their original order; a row whose only aliases were synthetic gets an empty cell. No canonical_name, note or attribution is read or written — the mode enforces that.
